title: RHEM - Runtime Hard-Example Mining for Agent Systems
description: RHEM is a runtime hard-example mining reference implementation for Agent systems. Version 0.3.0 adds opt-in hard-example distillation: pre-admission fractionation, feedback-ledger-based in-library re-distillation, core promotion, downweighting, culling, and rollback-governed patches. It does not claim production performance or statistical optimality.
notes: Prepared metadata for RHEM v0.3.0. Zenodo assigns the immutable version DOI when the corresponding GitHub release is archived.
